notes.title: Patch Notes 2.0 for 05-15-2025: Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
Thank you for supporting [i]Heromantic[/i]!

This week is [i]Heromantic[/i]’s 1-year anniversary, and to celebrate, I’m pleased to announce the latest update… [i]Heromantic[/i] now has Steam Achievements!

[b][u]New Features[/u]:[/b]
Steam Achievements: There are now four (4) Achievements that can be unlocked!

1. Star Player: [i]Attained all the endings in Luminary’s route![/i]
2. Newshound: [i]Attained all the endings in Beverly Boulevard’s route![/i]
3. Completionist: [i]Attained all the endings in both routes![/i]
4. Bonus: [i]Unlocked the special bonus scene![/i]

*For past players that already completed the game before this update, you will not have to replay the whole game to earn every Achievement! If you’ve already experienced all the endings in either or both routes, once this update is downloaded, all you will need to do is open the game, and up to three (3) of the four (4) Achievements (Star Player, Newshound, and/or Completionist) should automatically be earned. For the final achievement, relive the experience and enjoy the completed romance of a beloved hero!

[b][u]Changes[/u]:[/b]
Minor updates to some sprite and background assets, splash screen, and desktop icon.


[i][b]Troubleshooting:[/b][/i]
If an error occurs upon startup after downloading the patch update, please verify the integrity of the game files by right-clicking Heromantic's name under your Steam Library game list and going to "Properties." Then, go to "Installed Files" in the popup window and click "Verify integrity of game files." Steam will re-verify the downloaded files of the game, and once completed, the game should open normally again!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944429/34f045a3af4ea85ba51f2931ade211217a19965d.jpg[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944429/3e298bdc6d5f9e7eda274e3e7d3fbb06a913276c.jpg[/img]

If you’re a returning player and open the game to find that you didn’t earn some or any of the achievements, you may still have an ending or two that has yet to be achieved! For help on getting any or all of the endings, please refer to [url=https://janekoyama.wordpress.com/heromantic-walkthrough/]my game walkthrough guide[/url]!


If there are any other issues, please feel free to reach out so that I may review them accordingly.

Thank you again for your support!

notes.title: One Year of Heromantic!
notes.content:
Happy Birthday to [i]Heromantic[/i]! Today marks its one-year anniversary!

To celebrate, I have a special game update coming very soon. After receiving some player feedback, I will be implementing a new feature, so I hope players old and new will look forward to the addition!

Stay tuned for more information on this game update. Thank you for your continued support! See you then!

notes.title: Accessibility Menu: Readability Options
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Firstly, thank you to all who have played so far! It's truly been amazing and humbling. 🙇‍♀️

I just wanted to address that there's an [b]Accessibility Menu[/b] within the game to accommodate some special needs, including the options to change the in-game text font/size and text-to-speech! To access the menu, use [b][SHIFT + A][/b] (this is also noted in the Help Menu), and select whichever settings are desired. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944429/7be6174c1440bfe82b4e8488290800ca2420d941.png[/img]
Besides the default font, there are two other options: DejaVu Sans and Opendyslexic. This will specifically change the in-game dialogue, name boxes, choice options, and game menu font (in-game menu bar and main menu buttons will remain unaffected; apologies in advance). Due to each font's difference in size, kerning, and spacing, how the text appears in the dialogue box may vary in placement, so please adjust as needed with the Text Size Scaling and Line Spacing Scaling sliders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944429/d30a2eddd947c02497edf370ddafd755fe555337.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944429/558d81cff448734cc9a195aac6fba41691713516.png[/img]
There is also a [b]Help Menu[/b] that lists game controls, functions, keyboard shortcuts, and other tools!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944429/1f387cdd8d175b062e3bf5152da49aa4a074efea.png[/img]
I hope this helps anybody who needs it! Truly, thank you for playing [i]Heromantic[/i], and I wholeheartedly thank you for the interest and support!! (❁´◡`❁)

notes.title: Heromantic Walkthrough Guide Now Available!
notes.content: A walkthrough guide for Heromantic is now available!
